name: ValidRelToken_C
definition: ValidRelToken_C(C,r,x_r,tau_candidate) holds exactly when the source relation and source semantic record are defined, canonicalization and deriveRel_C are defined, tau_candidate is a well-formed RELATION_TOKEN_C using RELATION_TOKEN_C_V1, tau_candidate is exactly bound field-by-field to the canonical source payload, and tau_candidate is structurally equal to deriveRel_C(C,r,x_r).
structural_equality: Exact equality of token_schema and complete canonical_payload.
digest_rule: An optional digest is non-authoritative and is neither necessary nor sufficient for validity.

well_formed_token_definition.strict_schema_rule: An authoritative field outside token_schema and canonical_payload makes the token invalid. The existing optional payload_digest is permitted only when it is marked and treated as non-authoritative.

source_binding_definition.definition: TokenSourceBinding_C(C,r,x_r,tau_candidate) holds iff SourceRelation_C(C,r,x_r) holds, s_r is defined, p_r is defined, tau_candidate.canonical_payload is structurally equal to p_r, and every canonical payload field is equal to the corresponding governed source-derived value.
source_binding_definition.recovery_boundary: TokenSourceBinding_C means that the token payload can be audited against and recovered from the declared source semantic record. It does not claim that the original source object can be uniquely reconstructed from the token.
source_binding_definition.non_invertibility_rule: TokenSourceBinding_C does not imply global invertibility, injectivity, unique source reconstruction, or semantic identity across all possible contexts.

formal_definition.signature: ValidRelToken_C : (C : TYPE_CONTEXT) -> (r : TYPE_SOURCE_RELATION_EXPRESSION) -> (x_r : TYPE_SOURCE_REALIZATION) -> (tau_candidate : RELATION_TOKEN_C) -> Prop
formal_definition.structural_equality_rule: ==struct means exact structural equality of token_schema and complete canonical_payload. Optional non-authoritative digest equality is neither required nor sufficient.

success_result.meaning: The candidate token is structurally well formed, exactly source-bound, and structurally equal to deriveRel_C(C,r,x_r).

evaluation_order: Check prerequisite definitions and type bindings.
Check candidate token type and schema.
Check canonical payload completeness and field order.
Check absence of forbidden authoritative fields.
Check complete structural equality with the expected token.
Return VALID_REL_TOKEN_C or the first applicable diagnostic failure.
diagnostic_classifier.classifier_nonclaim: ValidateRelToken_C performs diagnostic classification only. It does not create a token, repair a token, transport a token, modify the witness, or prove preservation.

source_only_guard: Validity may not depend on d, x_d, target endpoints, target witnesses, project_w output, target traces, projection outcomes, Notebook 22 PASS labels, arbitrary discriminators, timestamps, commit IDs, filesystem paths, runtime IDs, database row IDs, or random salts.
validator_rule: ValidateRelToken_C may classify a token but may not create, complete, repair, normalize, or transport it.

failure_classification.failure_effect: The candidate is not valid for the declared source triple. No corrected token is emitted, no witness is modified, no projection is attempted, and no obligation status changes.

blocked_implications: ValidRelToken_C does not imply project_w success.
ValidRelToken_C does not imply token transport.
ValidRelToken_C does not imply target interpretation.
ValidRelToken_C does not imply semantic preservation.
ValidRelToken_C does not imply representable-distinction preservation.
ValidRelToken_C does not discharge OBL-D-001D or OBL-D-001E.
